text:
Priya Nair: quick day-before check for tomorrow's 10:30 AM onsite (SRE Sr). Can folks confirm coverage and who will run the debrief?
Jordan Li: I can run the debrief, happy to own scores.
Maya Kapoor: I can scribe notes and post the debrief summary. Will need the final rubric link though.
Priya Nair: awesome, thanks. @Maya here's the canonical rubric link: https://confluence.redwood/internals/hiring/rubric-v3 — focus areas: system design, troubleshooting, comms, and culture fit.
Maya Kapoor: got it, thanks. small question — is "latency tradeoffs" part of system design or troubleshooting?
Samir Patel: it's in system design per the rubric (weight 30% system design total). Troubleshooting is more live incident-style checks (20%).
Jordan Li: FYI I've blocked 30 mins after the interview for the debrief (calendar updated). Please join the invite: https://calendar.redwood/evt/abc123
Priya Nair: two operational asks: 1) please enable recording on the call (consent already collected) 2) enable transcription so we can attach snippets to the candidate file.
Interview Bot: Recording enabled by default for this organizer. Transcript will be available in ~1 hour post-call. :robot_face:
Maya Kapoor: thumbs up. also: who will handle the take-home follow-up question if candidate asks for clarification?
Jordan Li: I can field take-home logistics and send the follow-up note within 24h.
Priya Nair: perfect. last thing — reminder to everyone: use the score sheet under the candidate profile (don't DM scores). I'll copy the link in the invite. :memo:
Samir Patel: quick note on logistics — will be on phone for first 10m, joining zoom at ~10:40. Jordan / Maya you ok to start without me and summarize key bits when I join?
Jordan Li: yes, we'll start and leave a 5–10m buffer when you join.
Maya Kapoor: no problem. I'll capture the early notes and flag anything for Samir to weigh in on.
Priya Nair: thanks all — small checklist I sent to the invite: recorder on, scribe assigned, rubric link attached, debrief slot reserved. See you tomorrow. :v:
